name: Scrounging
summary: At Sigrun Ironhew's camp, defenses and supplies wait on scrap metal. She needs seven pieces, and nearby ogres carry plenty.

sections.title: A Camp Short of Materials
sections.body: Sigrun Ironhew needs materials for the camp's defenses and other needs. The Prospector worries about the camp's condition, so Sigrun wants to begin work soon. Scrap metal is what she lacks.

sections.title: The Ogres' Scrap
sections.body: Nearby ogres carry scrap metal, adding weight to talk of siege engines in the Badlands. Their main camp, Dustbelch Grotto, lies a long trek west of Sigrun's camp.

faq.q: Who is asking for the scrap metal?
faq.answer: Sigrun Ironhew needs scrap metal to build defenses and supply the camp.

faq.q: Why does the camp need scrap metal?
faq.answer: The camp lacks materials for defenses and other needs. The Prospector worries about its condition.

faq.q: Where can the scrap metal be found?
faq.answer: Nearby ogres carry scrap metal. Their main camp, Dustbelch Grotto, lies a long trek west of Sigrun's camp.
